head.label: Apply
head.title: Apply to join Smallfold
head.lead: Smallfold is open to YouTube channels with 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers, and joining is free.

email.label: Email
email.error: Enter an email address, like name@example.com.

phone.label: Phone
phone.hint: Include the country code, such as +1.
phone.error: Check the number, or leave this field empty.

channel.label: Link to your YouTube channel
channel.error: Enter the link to your channel, such as youtube.com/@yourchannel.

topic.label: What your channel is about
topic.hint: A sentence or two on the subjects you cover.
topic.error: Tell us briefly what your channel is about.

subscribers.label: Subscriber count
subscribers.hint: We work with channels of 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers.
subscribers.error: Enter your subscriber count in digits, such as 12000.
subscribers.errorRange: We work with channels of 1,000 to 50,000 subscribers.

form.subject: New creator application
form.privacy: We use these details to consider your application and to reply to you.

items.title: We reply
items.text: You hear from us within 2 working days.

items.title: We choose a sponsor
items.text: A person looks at your channel and chooses a sponsor that suits it.

items.title: You decide
items.text: You can turn down any sponsor we suggest, and commission applies only once a deal is done.
